pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against multiple scaling entries within a 300-second window to prevent stacked drawdowns during high-volatility wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require order flow volume confirmation and a zero-spread liquidity check on XAUUSD before placing any 0.01 lot order.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively lock in trailing profit stops once open trade PnL crosses +$12.00 to prevent degradation into losses.
